children: A whole host of companies will be reacting to their corporate actions during the upcoming week, mostly for the dividend announcement they had made earlier. Some of the companies will also be adjusting for their spin-offs and demergers as well. Here's a complete list of those companies:

The only major corporate action on Monday is the adjustment of HEG, which will have its record date for the demerger of its two separate entities, HEG Advanced Materials, and HEG Graphite Ltd. While HEG Advanced Materials will make its stock market debut today, HEG Graphite will list within the next 45 days.

Companies such as APL Apollo Tubes (Final Dividend of ₹8.5 per share), Globus Spirits (Final Dividend of ₹6.53), KDDL (Final Dividend of ₹8), will trade ex-dividend from Tuesday. The record date for TVS Holdings' Scheme of Arrangement of issuing 46 6% cumulative convertible redeemable preference shares for every one equity share held, has also been fixed for Tuesday.
Force Motors (Dividend of ₹50), Gujarat Narmada Valley Fertilizers & Chemicals (Final Dividend of ₹21), Travel Food Services (Dividend of ₹10.25), will be trading ex-dividend from Wednesday onwards.

Apex Frozen Foods (Final Dividend of ₹2.5), Power Mech Projects (Final Dividend of ₹1.5), TVS Srichakra (Final Dividend of ₹37.8), and Zee Entertainment (Final Dividend of ₹2), will adjust to their corporate actions on the penultimate trading day of the week.

A long list of companies will trade ex-dividend from Friday. They include the likes of Alphageo (India) (Final Dividend of ₹5), Apar Industries (Final Dividend of ₹60), Asahi India Glass (Final Dividend of ₹2), Astra Micro (Final Dividend of ₹2.4), Atul Auto (Final Dividend of ₹3), Balmer Lawrie (Final Dividend of ₹4.25), Blue Jet Healthcare (Final Dividend of ₹1.2), CMS Info Systems (Final Dividend of ₹2.5), CSL Finance (Final Dividend of ₹10), Datamatics Global Service (Final Dividend of ₹5), GSFC (Dividend of ₹5), Gujarat Energy (Final Dividend of ₹8.9), Heidelberg Cement (Final Dividend of ₹7), Mold-Tek Packaging (Final Dividend of ₹3), NSDL (Final Dividend of ₹4), Phoenix Mills (Final Dividend of ₹2.5), Rhi Magnesita (Final Dividend of ₹2.5), Shaily Engineering (Final Dividend of ₹3), Subros (Final Dividend of ₹3), Techno Electric & Engineering (Final Dividend of ₹7), and Venky's India (Final Dividend of ₹10).

title: Record Date Alert: These companies will trade ex-dividend, adjusted for demerger this week
